title: China Mail 1876-01-12
summary: THE SPIRIT OF THE MORNING PRESS. THE attitude which China may take on the Corean question is a matter of interest to all foreigners resident in the country. The Japan papers seem to rather expect that China will counsel Corea to offer amends for the insult she has passed on the Japanese flag. THE HONGKONG NATIVE PRESS. BREACH OF ORDINANCE NO 2 OF 1875. A RUNAWAY. LARCENY. YOKOHAMA. TO THE EDITOR O
